info.title: POD Platform API
info.description: REST API for the POD (Print-on-Demand) platform. All endpoints are mounted under /api/*. Authentication uses Sanctum bearer tokens for protected routes.

get.description: Returns 200 OK if the API is reachable. No authentication required.

post.summary: Authenticate and receive a Sanctum bearer token.
Reset the password using the emailed token.

delete.summary: Soft-delete the authenticated user. 409 if designer/printer with active items.

patch.summary: Update profile. current_password required when password is set.

get.summary: Public user read. Email/phone redacted unless requester is self or admin.

delete.summary: Designer: delete own profile. 409 if active designs.
Printer: delete own profile. 409 if active templates.
Admin: delete category. 409 if designs attached.
Admin: delete tag. 409 if designs attached.

get.summary: Public for published; owner/admin for draft/archived.

delete.summary: Designer: soft-delete own design. 409 if order_items reference it.
Printer: delete own template. 409 if order_items reference it.

post.summary: Printer: add variant to own template.

delete.summary: Printer: delete own variant. 409 if order_items reference it.

post.summary: Designer: create mapping. 409 on duplicate (design, template).

get.summary: Get own cart (items + grand total envelope).

post.summary: Add item (upserts on duplicate line per FR-6.6).

get.summary: List orders: customer sees own; admin sees all.

post.summary: Place an order from the current cart. Hard-deletes cart on success (DB transaction).

get.summary: Single order (customer own / designer own designs / printer own items / admin).

patch.summary: Customer (own, before processing) / admin. Fires OrderCancelled.
Admin: reassign printer (only when item status=pending).
Printer (own) / admin: update shipment. Fires OrderShipped / OrderDelivered.

post.summary: Customer (own) / admin: create payment for an order.
Admin broadcasts or targets a notification.

get.summary: List public platform settings (filtered by namespace).
Show a single setting (public if namespace is public, else admin only).
Users whose role is designer/printer_provider but lack a profile row.
Media rows whose owner is missing or soft-deleted.
Order items with status handed_off lacking a shipment.
Cart rows pointing to inactive product variants.
Order items needing action for the authenticated printer.
Alias of GET /api/orders filtered to the authenticated customer.
Active shipments for the authenticated customer.

User.description: Public user. Email and phone are redacted unless the requester is the user themselves or an admin.

UserWithToken.description: User shape returned by /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register. Includes the Sanctum bearer token.

CartResponse.description: Cart with line totals and grand total envelope.

shipping_address_id.description: If omitted, snapshot fields below are required

user_id.description: If null, broadcast to all users

PlatformOverview.description: Aggregated platform KPIs returned by the admin dashboard and admin overview report.

sanctum.description: Sanctum personal access token. Obtain via POST /api/auth/login or POST /api/auth/register.
